WITH counts AS (
                    SELECT u.id, COUNT(s.id)::int AS total
                      FROM usuarios_ext u
                      LEFT JOIN samples s
                        ON s.creador_id = u.id
                       AND s.eliminado_en IS NULL
                     GROUP BY u.id
               )
               UPDATE usuarios_ext u
                  SET total_samples = counts.total
                 FROM counts
                WHERE u.id = counts.id
